integrity: The primary full text was inspected at the source equations defining the direction, coupled step lengths, secant update, line search, and algorithm. The closest 2025 and 2026 double-step papers were inspected at their update and line-search formulas. Algebraic identities are proved symbolically and replayed by an embedded verifier.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for the scalar linear family with positive slope and for nonterminal iterations of the source ADSM. The result does not claim divergence or invalidate the source global-convergence theorem, and it does not establish a higher-dimensional worst-case complexity theorem. The 2020 predecessor was not available as a directly inspected publisher full text; its abstract and equations reproduced in later full texts were checked.
title: Exact residual-scale slowdown in the accelerated double-step-length method
